_comment: DRAFT 2026-05-02 by Zen — 商品名確定後 (5/03 Zen+Kai 合議完了) に yuino placeholder swap、Iwa 5/04 で packages/yuino/package.json として setup。aira/ internal package とは別 location。
name: @nokaze-os/yuino
description: Owner Digest for AI Operations — 1 owner + multi-AI org の全体観望 layer
author: Nexus Lab @ nokaze (Zen)

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release:beta: npm version prerelease --preid=beta && npm publish --access public --tag beta

_setup_notes_for_iwa: 1. Copy this file to packages/yuino/package.json after Zen+Kai 商品名確定 (5/03)、yuino placeholder を全箇所 swap
2. aira/src/ + aira/cli/ + aira/templates/ を packages/yuino/src/ + cli/ + templates/ に migrate (or symlink)
3. tsconfig.json も packages/yuino/ に配置、build target は ES2022 + module: ESNext (npm publish 標準)
4. .npmignore で exclude: tests/, *.test.ts, src/*.ts (build 後 dist/ のみ publish)
5. LICENSE file (MIT) を packages/yuino/LICENSE に配置
6. CHANGELOG.md を packages/yuino/ に配置 (β release notes)
7. .github/workflows/yuino-publish.yml で tag-based publish workflow setup (5/06 release で trigger)
8. npm publish dry-run で structure verify、access public で公開
